data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: Understand-Anything
data_tooling.summary: Understand-Anything 能将任意代码库转化为交互式知识图谱，让开发者可以直观地探索、搜索并提问代码逻辑。其核心创新在于利用图结构表示代码组件间的关联，将复杂系统变得可导航。你可以将其与 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编程助手集成，即时可视化项目架构并自然语言查询，从而加速新手上手和调试过程。
data_tooling.summary_en: Understand-Anything transforms any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph, enabling developers to explore, search, and ask questions about their code. Its key insight is using graph-based representations to capture relationships between code components, making complex systems navigable. You can integrate it with AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Copilot to instantly visualize and query your project's architecture, accelerating onboarding and debugging.

ui_devex.name: s-ui
ui_devex.summary: s-ui 是一款专为 SagerNet/Sing-Box 代理设计的进阶网页面板，旨在简化 Hysteria、Shadowsocks、VLESS 等多协议代理的配置与管理。其核心优势在于通过统一直观界面，将复杂设置流程化，降低手动配置错误率。技术亮点包括原生多协议支持、实时流量监控及灵活规则调整。部署于服务器后，可集中管理节点、监控网络状态并动态调整策略，适合个人或小团队搭建稳定易维护的代理基础设施，无需频繁修改配置文件即可快速切换协议或更新规则，提升运维效率。
ui_devex.summary_en: s-ui is an advanced web panel designed for managing SagerNet/Sing-Box proxies, simplifying the configuration of multi-protocol proxies like Hysteria, Shadowsocks, and VLESS. Its key strength lies in providing a unified, intuitive interface for complex proxy setups, reducing manual errors. You can deploy it to centrally manage proxy nodes, monitor traffic, and adjust rules in real time, making it ideal for personal or small-team proxy infrastructure management.

ui_devex.name: skills
ui_devex.summary: Skills 是一个面向 .NET 和 C# 开发的 AI 编码代理技能库，通过可复用模块化技能增强代理实用性。其核心将代码生成、测试、调试等常见任务封装为独立技能，支持按需组合调用，实现复杂工作流自动化。技术上强调组合性，开发者可像搭积木般自由搭配技能，定制专属开发助手。实际应用中，集成至 AI 代理后，可快速实现 .NET 项目脚手架搭建、单元测试自动生成或代码审查，是提升 AI 辅助 .NET 开发效率的开箱即用工具集。
ui_devex.summary_en: Skills is a repository of reusable, modular capabilities that enhance AI coding agents for .NET and C# development. It provides pre-built skills like code generation, testing, and debugging, enabling agents to perform complex tasks reliably. The project emphasizes composability, allowing developers to mix and match skills for custom workflows. Practically, you can integrate these skills into your AI agent to automate .NET project scaffolding, unit test creation, or code review. It's a practical toolkit for boosting AI-assisted .NET productivity.

agents_workflows.name: agency-agents
agents_workflows.summary: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and processes, enabling modular collaboration where each agent handles specific tasks like frontend development or content moderation. Developers can deploy these agents via the provided API, customize existing agents for new domains, or combine them to create complex workflows, making it practical for automating multi-step projects requiring varied expertise.

agents_workflows.name: Understand-Anything
agents_workflows.summary: Understand-Anything 能将任意代码库转化为交互式知识图谱，让开发者可以直观地探索、搜索并提问代码逻辑。其核心创新在于利用图结构表示代码组件间的关联，将复杂系统变得可导航。你可以将其与 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编程助手集成，即时可视化项目架构并自然语言查询，从而加速新手上手和调试过程。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Understand-Anything transforms any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph, enabling developers to explore, search, and ask questions about their code. Its key insight is using graph-based representations to capture relationships between code components, making complex systems navigable. You can integrate it with AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Copilot to instantly visualize and query your project's architecture, accelerating onboarding and debugging.

agents_workflows.name: skills
agents_workflows.summary: Skills 是一个面向 .NET 和 C# 开发的 AI 编码代理技能库，通过可复用模块化技能增强代理实用性。其核心将代码生成、测试、调试等常见任务封装为独立技能，支持按需组合调用，实现复杂工作流自动化。技术上强调组合性，开发者可像搭积木般自由搭配技能，定制专属开发助手。实际应用中，集成至 AI 代理后，可快速实现 .NET 项目脚手架搭建、单元测试自动生成或代码审查，是提升 AI 辅助 .NET 开发效率的开箱即用工具集。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Skills is a repository of reusable, modular capabilities that enhance AI coding agents for .NET and C# development. It provides pre-built skills like code generation, testing, and debugging, enabling agents to perform complex tasks reliably. The project emphasizes composability, allowing developers to mix and match skills for custom workflows. Practically, you can integrate these skills into your AI agent to automate .NET project scaffolding, unit test creation, or code review. It's a practical toolkit for boosting AI-assisted .NET productivity.

agents_workflows.name: forge
agents_workflows.summary: Forge是一个Python框架，用于构建自托管的多步骤智能体工作流，核心能力是让大语言模型调用工具并执行复杂任务。其技术亮点在于模块化设计：将工具定义、LLM后端（如Ollama、llama.cpp）和工作流逻辑解耦，开发者可灵活组合组件。例如，定义搜索和计算工具后，LLM能自动决定调用顺序。实际应用中，Forge适合构建本地AI助手，用于自动化数据检索、文档处理或代码生成，所有数据本地处理以保障隐私。用户可从单步工具调用逐步扩展为多步骤流程。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Forge is a Python framework for building self-hosted, multi-step agentic workflows with LLM tool-calling. Its key insight is a modular design that separates tool definitions, LLM backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, etc.), and workflow logic, enabling flexible composition. Use it to create custom AI agents that chain function calls, retrieve data, or automate tasks—all running locally for privacy and control.

deployment_serving.name: s-ui
deployment_serving.summary: s-ui 是一款专为 SagerNet/Sing-Box 代理设计的进阶网页面板，旨在简化 Hysteria、Shadowsocks、VLESS 等多协议代理的配置与管理。其核心优势在于通过统一直观界面，将复杂设置流程化，降低手动配置错误率。技术亮点包括原生多协议支持、实时流量监控及灵活规则调整。部署于服务器后，可集中管理节点、监控网络状态并动态调整策略，适合个人或小团队搭建稳定易维护的代理基础设施，无需频繁修改配置文件即可快速切换协议或更新规则，提升运维效率。
deployment_serving.summary_en: s-ui is an advanced web panel designed for managing SagerNet/Sing-Box proxies, simplifying the configuration of multi-protocol proxies like Hysteria, Shadowsocks, and VLESS. Its key strength lies in providing a unified, intuitive interface for complex proxy setups, reducing manual errors. You can deploy it to centrally manage proxy nodes, monitor traffic, and adjust rules in real time, making it ideal for personal or small-team proxy infrastructure management.

The project emphasizes composability, allowing developers to mix and match skills for custom workflows. Practically, you can integrate these skills into your AI agent to automate .NET project scaffolding, unit test creation, or code review. It's a practical toolkit for boosting AI-assisted .NET productivity.

summary_short.zh: Skills 是一个面向 .NET 和 C# 开发的 AI 编码代理技能库，通过可复用模块化技能增强代理实用性。其核心将代码生成、测试、调试等常见任务封装为独立技能，支持按需组合调用，实现复杂工作流自动化。技术上强调组合性，开发者可像搭积木般自由搭配技能，定制专属开发助手。实际应用中，集成至 AI 代理后，可快速实现 .NET 项目脚手架搭建、单元测试自动生成或代码审查，是提升 AI 辅助 .NET 开发效率的开箱即用工具集。

framework_core.name: forge
framework_core.summary: Forge是一个Python框架，用于构建自托管的多步骤智能体工作流，核心能力是让大语言模型调用工具并执行复杂任务。其技术亮点在于模块化设计：将工具定义、LLM后端（如Ollama、llama.cpp）和工作流逻辑解耦，开发者可灵活组合组件。例如，定义搜索和计算工具后，LLM能自动决定调用顺序。实际应用中，Forge适合构建本地AI助手，用于自动化数据检索、文档处理或代码生成，所有数据本地处理以保障隐私。用户可从单步工具调用逐步扩展为多步骤流程。
framework_core.summary_en: Forge is a Python framework for building self-hosted, multi-step agentic workflows with LLM tool-calling. Its key insight is a modular design that separates tool definitions, LLM backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, etc.), and workflow logic, enabling flexible composition. Use it to create custom AI agents that chain function calls, retrieve data, or automate tasks—all running locally for privacy and control.
